research.title: Robustness Evaluation of Semantic Segmentation Under Image Degradation
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing segmentation models under blur, compression, and illumination changes while holding training splits and preprocessing settings fixed.
Analyzed classwise overlap scores and boundary errors to characterize degradation patterns affecting small objects and visually similar categories.

research.title: Evaluation of Confidence Calibration for Visual Defect Classification
bullets: Designed experiments comparing temperature scaling and uncalibrated classifiers across surface defect datasets, with separate calibration partitions and acquisition condition shifts.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, calibration errors, and selective prediction curves to examine confidence behavior for rare defects and ambiguous surface textures.

publications.title: Confidence Calibration for Visual Defect Classification Under Acquisition Shifts
Selective Prediction and Error Analysis in Surface Defect Inspection

work.title: Image Ingestion and Validation Utilities
bullets: Implemented image ingestion utilities that checked file formats, normalized metadata, and routed unreadable uploads to existing error handling workflows.
Added regression tests for malformed image inputs and revised validation messages to support troubleshooting during routine application maintenance.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Classification Transfer Learning
bullets: Implemented frozen feature extraction and partial fine tuning for pretrained image classifiers using consistent preprocessing and stratified dataset splits.
Compared classification accuracy, training behavior, and confusion patterns to assess how adaptation strategies affected categories with limited training examples.

projects.title: Classical and Neural Approaches to Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented median filtering, bilateral filtering, and a convolutional denoising baseline for images corrupted with synthetic Gaussian and impulse noise.
Compared reconstruction metrics and inspected edge preservation across noise conditions, documenting differences between pixelwise error and visible texture loss.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching for Planar Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented patch descriptors and a learned descriptor baseline within a shared feature matching workflow for planar image pairs.
Compared matching precision and homography reprojection errors under viewpoint and lighting changes, inspecting failed alignments caused by repetitive textures.
